<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="2Kg2-udhUDzqL9zP3IV3"> <mxGraphModel grid="1" page="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam backgroundColor white
skinparam roundcorner 5
skinparam BoxPadding 10
skinparam linetype ortho

title Traffic Perception & Acquisition - Decoupled Pipeline Architecture

' ==========================================
' CẤU TRÚC DỮ LIỆU PHẲNG
' ==========================================
struct Detection <<struct>> {
 + Box: cv::Rect
 + ClassId: int
 + Confidence: float
}

struct FrameContext <<struct>> {
 + FrameId: int
 + Frame: cv::Mat
 + Detections: std::vector<Detection>
 + LaneId: int
 + VehicleCount: int
}

struct AppConfig <<struct>> {
 + RtspUrls: std::array<std::string, 4>
 + ModelPath: std::string
 + MaxQueueSize: int = 1
 + TargetFps: int
}

' ==========================================
' LAYER 0: THE ORCHESTRATOR
' ==========================================
class PerceptionModule {
 - ConfigManager: ConfigManager
 - Watchdog: StreamWatchdog
 - Workers: std::array<StreamWorker, 4>
 - Queues: std::array<SafeFrameQueue, 4>
 - Engine: InferenceEngine
 - Analyzer: TrafficAnalyzer
 - Viewer: MultiLaneViewer
 - Publisher: SnapshotPublisher
 - Telemetry: TelemetryManager
 - SnapshotSender: MQSnapshotSender
 - PipelineHead: PipelineNode*
 + initModule(configPath: std::string): bool
 + startThreads(): void
 + stopThreads(): void
}

' ==========================================
' LAYER 1: ACQUISITION & QUEUES
' ==========================================
class ConfigManager {
 - ConfigFile: std::string
 - CachedConfig: AppConfig
 + loadConfig(): bool
 + getConfig(): AppConfig
}

class StreamWorker {
 - LaneId: int
 - Config: AppConfig
 - RtspStream: cv::VideoCapture
 + initStream(cfg: AppConfig, id: int): bool
 + producerLoop(queue: SafeFrameQueue&): void
 + getHealthStatus(): int
}

class StreamWatchdog {
 + monitorHealth(worker: const StreamWorker&): void
 + recoverStream(worker: StreamWorker&, cfg: AppConfig): void
}

class SafeFrameQueue {
 - Mutex: std::mutex
 - InternalQueue: std::queue<FrameContext>
 + enqueue_with_overwrite(ctx: FrameContext&&): void
 + dequeue_non_blocking(ctx: FrameContext&): bool
}

' ==========================================
' LAYER 2: INFERENCE & CORE PIPELINE STAGES
' ==========================================
class ModelBackend {
 - InternalModelPtr: void*
 + init(modelPath: std::string): bool
 + detect(frame: const cv::Mat&): std::vector<Detection>
}

class InferenceEngine {
 - Config: AppConfig
 - Model: ModelBackend
 - ActiveQueues: std::array<SafeFrameQueue*, 4>
 + NextStage: PipelineNode*
 + consumerRoundRobinLoop(): void
 + executeInference(ctx: FrameContext&): void
}

class TrafficAnalyzer {
 + ZoneId: int
 - ViewerPtr: MultiLaneViewer*
 + initViewer(v: MultiLaneViewer*): void
 + trackAndAnalyze(ctx: FrameContext&): void
}

class SnapshotPublisher {
 + BrokerUrl: std::string
 - TelemetryPtr: TelemetryManager*
 - SenderPtr: ISnapshotSender*
 + initTelemetry(t: TelemetryManager*): void
 + initSender(s: ISnapshotSender*): void
 + broadcastSnapshot(ctx: FrameContext&): void
}

' Thẻ biến hình (Variant Node) chuẩn ngữ nghĩa Stage
struct PipelineNode <<struct>> {
 + Stage: std::variant<TrafficAnalyzer, SnapshotPublisher>
 + Next: PipelineNode*
}

' ==========================================
' LAYER 3: SINK / LEAF COMPONENTS (Các nhánh phụ ngoài luồng)
' ==========================================
class MultiLaneViewer {
 + WindowName: std::string
 + updateLaneView(ctx: FrameContext&): void
}

class TelemetryManager {
 + TotalCycles: int
 + showTelemetryMetrics(ctx: FrameContext&): void
}

interface ISnapshotSender {
 + open(): bool
 + send(snapshot: FrameContext&): bool
 + close(): void
}

class MQSnapshotSender <<POSIX_Message_Queue>> {
 - mqDescriptor : mqd_t
 - queueName : char*
 - attributes : mq_attr
 + open() : bool
 + send(snapshot : FrameContext&) : bool
 + close() : void
}

class HealthReporter {
 - signalBuffer: std::vector<bool>
 + sendStartSignal(): void
 + sendEndSignal(): void
}

' ==========================================
' MA TRẬN MỐI QUAN HỆ CHUẨN KIẾN TRÚC ĐA HÌNH TĨNH
' ==========================================
FrameContext *-- Detection : \"contains\"
ConfigManager *-- AppConfig : \"manages\"

' Quyền sở hữu của Orchestrator
PerceptionModule *-- ConfigManager
PerceptionModule *-- StreamWatchdog
PerceptionModule *-- \"4\" StreamWorker
PerceptionModule *-- \"4\" SafeFrameQueue
PerceptionModule *-- InferenceEngine
PerceptionModule *-- TrafficAnalyzer
PerceptionModule *-- MultiLaneViewer
PerceptionModule *-- SnapshotPublisher
PerceptionModule *-- TelemetryManager
PerceptionModule *-- MQSnapshotSender

' Luồng Config & Đa luồng 4 làn
ConfigManager ..> StreamWorker : \"injects config\"
ConfigManager ..> InferenceEngine : \"injects config\"
StreamWorker --> AppConfig : \"reads\"
InferenceEngine --> AppConfig : \"reads\"
StreamWatchdog ..> StreamWorker : \"monitors\"
StreamWorker \"1\" --> \"1\" SafeFrameQueue : \"pushes data\"
InferenceEngine \"1\" o--> \"4\" SafeFrameQueue : \"polls\"
InferenceEngine *-- ModelBackend : \"owns\"
InferenceEngine --> HealthReporter : \"depends\"
TelemetryManager --> HealthReporter : \"depends\"

' --- LUỒNG PIPELINE TUYẾN TÍNH ĐỘC LẬP TUYỆT ĐỐI ---
InferenceEngine -> PipelineNode : \"triggers pipeline\"
PipelineNode --> PipelineNode : \"Next\"
PipelineNode o-- TrafficAnalyzer : \"«variant»\"
PipelineNode o-- SnapshotPublisher : \"«variant»\"

' --- CÁC KẾT NỐI SINK ĐẦU RA PHỤ ---
TrafficAnalyzer --> MultiLaneViewer : \"calls via IAnalyzedView\"
SnapshotPublisher --> TelemetryManager : \"calls via ITelemetry\"

' =========================================================
' 🌟 KẾT NỐI ĐẦU RA SNAPSHOT GIAO TIẾP QUA INTERFACE
' =========================================================
MQSnapshotSender .up.|> ISnapshotSender : \"implements\"
SnapshotPublisher o--> ISnapshotSender : \"delegates transmission to\"

' ==========================================
interface IAnalyzedView {
 + {abstract} updateLaneView(ctx : FrameContext&) : void
}

interface ISnapshotSender {
 + {abstract} open() : bool
 + {abstract} send(snapshot : FrameContext&) : void
 + {abstract} close() : void
}

interface ILogger {
 + {abstract} log(msg : std::string) : void
 + {abstract} logError(msg : std::string) : void
}

interface IStartReport {
 + {abstract} reportExecutionStart() : void
}

interface IEndReport {
 + {abstract} reportExecutionEnd() : void
}

' ==========================================
' STRUCTS & DATA MODELS
' ==========================================
struct AppConfig {
 + rtspUrl : std::string
 + inferenceBatchSize : int
 + frameRate : int
}

struct Detection {
 + box : cv::Rect
 + classId : int
 + confidence : float
}

struct FrameContext {
 + frameId : uint64_t
 + rawImage : cv::Mat
 + timestamp : uint64_t
 + detections : std::vector<Detection>
 + laneMetrics : LaneMetrics
}

' ==========================================
' SYSTEM CORE CLASSES
' ==========================================
class PerceptionModule {
 - configManager : ConfigManager
 - watchdog : StreamWatchdog
 - workers : std::vector<StreamWorker*>
 - pipelineManager : PipelineManager
 - healthReporter : IHealthReporter*
 - viewer : IAnalyzedView*
 - logger : ILogger
 - logAnalyzer : LogAnalyzer
 + initModule(configPath : std::string) : bool
 + startThreads() : void
 + stopThreads() : void
}

class StreamWatchdog <<SCHED_FIFO P90>> {
 + monitorStreams() : void
}

class StreamWorker <<SCHED_FIFO P80>> {
 - config : AppConfig
 - queue : SafeFrameQueue&
 + captureLoop() : void
}

class SafeFrameQueue <<Lock-Free>> {
 - queue : std::atomic<FrameContext*>
 + push_with_overwrite(ctx : FrameContext&&) : void
 + pop_non_blocking(ctx : FrameContext&) : bool
}

class ConfigManager {
 - configFile : std::string
 - cachedConfig : AppConfig
 + loadConfig() : bool
 + getConfig() : AppConfig
}

class PipelineManager <<SCHED_FIFO P75>> {
 - isRunning : std::atomic<bool>
 - pipelineThread : std::thread
 - inputQueue : SafeFrameQueue&
 - inferenceEngine : InferenceEngine*
 - trafficAnalyzer : TrafficAnalyzer*
 - publisher : SnapshotPublisher*
 - pipelineLoop() : void
 + start() : void
 + stop() : void
}

class InferenceEngine {
 - config : AppConfig
 - backend : ModelBackend
 - healthReporter : HealthReporter*
 + executeInference(ctx : FrameContext&) : void
}

class ModelBackend {
 - modelPath : std::string
 + loadModel() : bool
 + predict(img : cv::Mat) : std::vector<Detection>
}

class TrafficAnalyzer {
 - zoneId : int
 - viewerPtr : IAnalyzedView*
 + trackAndAnalyze(ctx : FrameContext&) : void
}

class OpenCVLanesViewer <<SCHED_FIFO P60>> {
 - windowName : std::string
 - periodicThread : std::thread
 - frameBuffer : DoubleBuffer<FrameContext>
 - renderLoop() : void
 + updateLaneView(ctx : FrameContext&) : void
}

class SnapshotPublisher {
 - logger : ILogger*
 - brokerUrl : std::string
 - sender : ISnapshotSender*
 - healthReporter : HealthReporter*
 - benchmarkBuffer : std::vector<BenchmarkEntry>
 + broadcastSnapshot(ctx : FrameContext&) : void
 + logError(errCtx : ErrorCtx) : void
 + logTelemetry() : void
}

class POSIX_MQS_MCRecordSender {
 - mqDescriptor : int
 - queueName : std::string
 + open() : bool
 + send(snapshot : FrameContext&) : void
 + close() : void
}

class HealthReporter {
 - startTimes : std::unordered_map<uint64_t, struct timespec>
 + reportExecutionStart() : void
 + reportExecutionEnd() : void
}

class LogAnalyzer {
 - logger : ILogger*
 + analyzeLogs() : void
 + printResult() : void
}

' ==========================================
' RELATIONSHIPS & DEPENDENCIES
' ==========================================
PerceptionModule *-- ConfigManager
PerceptionModule *-- StreamWatchdog
PerceptionModule *-- \"4\" StreamWorker
PerceptionModule *-- PipelineManager
PerceptionModule *-- HealthReporter
PerceptionModule *-- IAnalyzedView
PerceptionModule *-- ILogger
PerceptionModule *-- LogAnalyzer

StreamWatchdog --> \"4\" StreamWorker : \"monitors\"

StreamWorker ..> AppConfig : \"reads\"
StreamWorker --> SafeFrameQueue : \"pushes data\"

PipelineManager --> SafeFrameQueue : \"pops data\"
PipelineManager *-- InferenceEngine
PipelineManager *-- TrafficAnalyzer
PipelineManager *-- SnapshotPublisher

FrameContext *-- Detection

InferenceEngine *-- ModelBackend
InferenceEngine ..> AppConfig : \"reads\"
InferenceEngine o-- IStartReport : \"reports start\"
InferenceEngine ..> FrameContext : \"enriches\"

TrafficAnalyzer --> IAnalyzedView : \"calls via\"
TrafficAnalyzer ..> FrameContext : \"enriches\"

OpenCVLanesViewer ..|> IAnalyzedView : \"implements\"
OpenCVLanesViewer ..> FrameContext : \"consumes (double buffer)\"

SnapshotPublisher --> ISnapshotSender : \"delegates transmission\"
SnapshotPublisher o-- IEndReport : \"reports end\"
SnapshotPublisher ..> FrameContext : \"consumes & benchmarks\"
SnapshotPublisher *.. ILogger : \"logs\"

POSIX_MQS_MCRecordSender ..|> ISnapshotSender : \"implements\"

ILogger --o LogAnalyzer : \"analyzes logs\"

HealthReporter --|> IStartReport
HealthReporter --|> IEndReport

ConfigManager *-- AppConfig

@enduml
